translations.english: "The prowess and exceeding energy of Ravana as flames, his sighs as smoke, his own strength as heat, endowed with might, that fire of Rakshasa has been extinguished by the rainy cloud in the shape of Rama in the battlefield."
translations.hindi: जंगल में अकेलो ओर दीन बेचारी वैदेही को बरजोरी हर ल्ला कर, तू अपने को बहादुर लगाता है
